messages:
miriam: Noticed a customer spike yesterday where cost jumped but token counts stayed flat. Suspect model variant routing / quantization mismatch. Can we add a 'surge inspector' view that ties cost to model_variant_id + quantization tag?

josh: Good catch. If tokens flat but $ up, likely different sku routing (e.g., switched from 8-bit to fp16 variant) or new kernel fallback. We currently only store model_sku at a high level.

rachel: We do have model_sku in invocation events, but we drop quantization and variant metadata for rate reasons. Adding a tiny tag (variant_id) per sampled invocation could help. 1% sample should be enough for root-cause.

tom: UX: inspector should show a matrix: time x (model_variant, region) with columns: tokens, billed_tokens, cost_usd, cache_saved_tokens, requests. Color by cost delta. Hover -> last routing decision stack.

sam: For alerts, create rule: cost_per_token for tenant > 2x baseline and tokens stable -> open ticket + attach top variants. Avoid noisy alerts by requiring 3 windows (5m each).

miriam: Implementation plan: add variant_id and quant_tag to sampled invocation log, emit sample stream to kafka->clickhouse materialized table. Then enrich billing pipeline to calculate cost_per_token by variant.

rachel: Proposed schema change (sampled table):
```sql
CREATE TABLE invocation_sampled (
  ts DateTime,
  tenant_id String,
  model_sku String,
  variant_id String,
  quant_tag String,
  tokens UInt32,
  tokens_billed UInt32,
  cache_hit Bool
) ENGINE = MergeTree() ORDER BY (tenant_id, ts);
```

josh: Nice. Once we have that we can compute per-variant unit economics and roll up to routes. Also surface 'discrepancy' metric: tokens_billed - tokens_observed, to catch billing regressions.

tom: Console filter: let users pivot by route or by tenant cohort and then expand to variant heatmap. Also an action: 'replay sample' that submits sampled traces to the eval infra to check if inference path changed.

sam: Rate-limiting: sample writes must be throttled; maybe per-tenant sampling budget (burst allowed). We'll need a schema for sampling config in control plane.

rachel: Agree. I'll add a sampling config: percent, max_per_minute, sticky for hotspots. Defaults: 0.5% global, 2% for top-10 tenants.

miriam: Ownership: @rachel owns the pipeline bits, @josh owns alert thresholds, @sam owns replay api, @tom handles Console UI. I'll write the product blurb for the feature.

billing-bot: billing-bot: created alert rule cost_discrepancy_high for staging (threshold: 2x baseline, window 15m)

josh: One more ask: add model_version hash to billing export so finance can reconcile invoices by model variant. Small change but saves a lot of back-and-forth.

rachel: I'll add variant_id to billing export schema and run a backfill for last 7 days in staging to validate joins.

miriam: Timeline? MVP: sampling table + console pivot + one alert in staging in 2w. Small scope first, then auto-sample increase for impacted tenants.

sam: I'll prototype replay endpoint this week against staging samples.

tom: I'll draft Console mockups and post in #design by Fri.

miriam: Great. Thanks team — this should cut mean-time-to-root-cause on cost spikes dramatically. :rocket:
